_comment: Pinned real-OSS-repo NEGATIVE corpus for the false-positive benchmark. These are mature, permissively-licensed projects across languages; HEAD at the pinned SHA is treated as benign production code (popular repos very rarely carry a live secret in HEAD). fetch.py clones each at its exact SHA. Ground-truth caveat: this measures ALERTS PER 1,000 REAL FILES, not hand-verified FP rate — a small fraction of alerts could be genuine leaks; cross-tool disagreement (a file only one tool flags) is the strong FP signal. See RESULTS.md.
